description: This Java source file defines the SparkLauncher class, which provides programmatic control for launching Spark applications as child processes. It includes configuration options, process management, and logging redirection features.

classes.name: SparkLauncher
classes.description: Main class for configuring and launching Spark applications programmatically, supporting process management, environment setup, and logging.

methods.name: setConfig
methods.description: Sets a configuration value for the launcher library, affecting launcher behavior.

methods.name: setJavaHome
methods.description: Sets a custom JAVA_HOME for launching Spark applications.

methods.name: directory
methods.description: Sets the working directory for the Spark submit process.

methods.name: redirectError
methods.description: Redirects stderr to a specified ProcessBuilder.Redirect.

methods.name: redirectOutput
methods.description: Redirects stdout to a specified ProcessBuilder.Redirect.

methods.name: redirectError
methods.description: Redirects stderr to a specified file.

methods.name: redirectOutput
methods.description: Redirects stdout to a specified file.

methods.name: redirectToLog
methods.description: Redirects stdout and stderr to a logger with the specified name.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches a subprocess to start the configured Spark application.

methods.name: startApplication
methods.description: Starts a Spark application with control over the child process and logging.

methods.name: createBuilder
methods.description: Creates a ProcessBuilder configured to launch the Spark application.

methods.name: findSparkSubmit
methods.description: Determines the path to the spark-submit script based on OS.

methods.name: getLoggerName
methods.description: Retrieves the logger name for logging child process output.
